integrity: Operator-theoretic Neumann argument and an explicit one-dimensional counterexample. No empirical or formal-computer certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence of freely preconditioned approximate controlled g-duality and exact controlled g-duality follows almost immediately from the original definition and its own Corollary 3.8(ii); it is contextual, not a new general operator theorem.

The substantive correction concerns the false unpreconditioned approximation conclusion and the unjustified Neumann series in Corollary 3.8(i),(iii). The inverse-dual identity in part (i) is not disputed.
Convergence of other operator series under additional spectral assumptions is not addressed; an unindexed erratum may already note the specific correction.
title: Adjustable preconditioning collapses approximate controlled \(g\)-duality to exact \(g\)-duality
